title: Don't answer it yet.
line: The first thing they say is rarely the real thing. Answer it fast and you have answered the wrong one, confidently.

title: Find out what they actually mean.
line: One question, not three. "When you say the timing's off — what's happening between now and then?"

title: Say it back.
line: In their words, not yours. They need to hear that you got it before they will hear anything else.

title: Now reframe.
line: One frame, not three. This is the first moment it belongs.

title: Check it landed.
line: "Does that change how you're seeing it?" If it didn't, you reframed the wrong thing. Go back to step two.

title: Pick up where you were.
line: Don't restart the close. Carry on from the sentence you were in the middle of.
